questions.subject: mathematics
questions.content: The students S<sub>1</sub>, S<sub>2</sub>, ....., S<sub>10</sub> are to be divided into 3 groups A, B and C such that each group has at least one student and the group C has at most 3 students. Then the total number of possibilities of forming such groups is ___________.
questions.explanation:
If group C has one student then number of groups

= 10C1 [29 – 2] = 5100

If group C has two students then number of groups

= 10C2 [28 – 2] = 11430

If group C has three students then number of groups

= 10C3 × [27 – 2] = 15120

So total groups = 31650
